_comment: What export_and_upload.py produces for Kimi K2.6 at rank 32 — recorded here
so you can eyeball a real conversion against it. You do not write this file;
build_lora_adapter does, and target_modules comes from whatever modules Tinker
actually trained (train_attn/train_mlp on the training client).
Sail requires: peft_type LORA, task_type CAUSAL_LM, r <= 32, and
base_model_name_or_path naming the model registered in supported_models.
Sail does not restrict Kimi K2.6 to a target-module allowlist, so a narrow
list like [q_proj, v_proj] is not required — and would drop trained modules.
